entries.wording: The shipment has been successfully picked up and is being prepared for transportation
entries.note: The tracker ends it with a space, which the adapter drops.

entries.wording: The shipment arrives at the distribution center and is prepared for transport to the next destination.
The shipment is dispatched from the transit center to the next destination
Your package has been loaded and is on its way to you
entries.note: The delivery van's loading, hours before a delivery on the same morning and once for each delivery run; the shared rules would read it as transit.

entries.wording: Delivery failed because the address could not be found
Delivery failed, customer refused to accept
entries.note: The courier loads the parcel for another delivery round the next morning.
The parcel is on its way back to the sender, after a failed delivery.

entries.wording: Your package has been successfully delivered.
entries.note: The tracker follows it with the delivery type in 【】, such as Left with neighbor, and its customer service line. The adapter keeps a delivery type the site offers, out of brackets, and drops the rest.
